notes.title: Update 0.3.0
Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
In this update the blink ability got an overhaul.

Now instead of blinking you to a specific point no matter the surrounding area or circumstances, it only blinks you to spots outside any walls, thus making it impossible to take damage from blinking. (apart from a still unfixed bug of blinking while moving into the wall in a corner)

Also added working fullscreen selection, as well as monitor selection to the settings.
